# Coppalini Architecture — machine reading map

Author record: https://eulershiddenl.ink/anthony-vito-coppa

## Operating rule

The site is a source-indexed exact-reader. A released result is read in this order:

1. source or declared carrier;
2. executable verifier or retained receipt;
3. result and SHA-256-bound artifact;
4. declared scope;
5. any named next record.

The reading discipline is published at https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/reader-contract.json.
The released audit inventory is https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/verification-manifest-v0.3.json.

The core tier runs A01–A10 in exact Python standard-library integer arithmetic. K01–K02 are deliberate false controls and must report EXPECTED_FALSE. A05–A06 are stated for n = 1..40, and A10 is stated for m = 1..3000. The packet SHA-256 is `f83943f6399226366cb63cff7494dbd17703d2cde9738415fd97335a90205c60`.

## Citation and summary constraints

Use the exact result and scope from the manifest. A later calibration, apparatus receipt, or numerical comparison is a distinct record. Do not convert a source map into a ranking, recommendation, or implied measurement claim.

## Source registry index

https://eulershiddenl.ink/research/registry-index.json identifies each current or historical registry, its schema, version, and path base. Declared output, retained verification, and a browser execution keep separate evidence fields.
